rules.text: Platform access fee of $500.00 per month.
API calls are billed on graduated tiers: the first 100,000 calls at $0.0100, calls 100,001-500,000 at $0.0080, and calls above 500,000 at $0.0060.
500 GB of storage is included. Storage above 500 GB is billed at $0.25 per GB, measured at the peak daily storage in the billing month.
Renewal loyalty discount: 10% off API call charges for the 2026 contract year.
Billing disputes must be raised within 30 days of the invoice date.
